name: hello-lobster
description: Your first OpenClaw workflow: read arguments, run steps in order, and pass JSON from one step to the next.

language.description: Greeting language: en, zh, es, fr or de

steps.run: node -e 'const words = { en: "Hello", zh: "你好", es: "Hola", fr: "Bonjour", de: "Hallo" }; const word = words[process.env.LOBSTER_ARG_LANGUAGE] || words.en; console.log(JSON.stringify({ greeting: word + ", " + process.env.LOBSTER_ARG_NAME + "!" }))'

node -e 'const os = require("os"); console.log(JSON.stringify({ platform: os.platform(), node: process.version, cpus: os.cpus().length, uptimeHours: Math.round(os.uptime() / 3600), time: new Date().toISOString() }))'

node -e 'const facts = JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0, "utf8")); console.log(JSON.stringify({ message: process.env.GREETING + " This workflow ran on " + facts.platform + " (Node " + facts.node + ", " + facts.cpus + " CPUs) at " + facts.time + ".", facts: facts }))'
